product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Leahlyn Traditional Ornate 5 Drawer Chest of Drawers, Warm Brown
features: TRADITIONAL CHEST OF DRAWERS: Create a look of refined elegance in your bedroom with this classically designed chest of drawers. Finished in a warm, natural brown with European styling for a boost of flair
HANDSOME CRAFTSMANSHIP: Drawer chest made of select birch veneers, wood and engineered wood. Dovetail construction drawers with a center metal glide system for ultra-smooth use
ORNATE DETAILS: Elegant European styling makes this drawer chest truly shine with pilaster and acanthus accents. Antiqued brass-tone bail pulls and knobs create a lovingly timeworn feel
ORGANIZATION MADE EASY: Never worry about storage space again with 5 smooth-operating drawers for all of your clothes and belongings. This drawer storage unit measures 35.5" W x 17.5" D x 51" H
MINOR ASSEMBLY: All you need is a screwdriver to attach feet to chest. Instructions and hardware included
DIRECT FROM THE MANUFACTURER: Ashley Furniture goes the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner

BUY WITH CONFIDENCE: Designed and manufactured by Ashley Furniture Industries. The trusted source for stylish furniture, lighting, rugs, accessories and mattresses. For every taste and budget. Since 1945
description: If you love the look of traditional design, this chest of drawers may be the one for you. Pilaster and acanthus accents and antiqued brass-tone bail pulls and knobs are all hallmarks of European styling in your newfound classic. Whether you need a space to get ready in front of the mirror or need a temporary double vanity solution, you’re sure to find the right combination with our wide selection. Your dream master bedroom dresser is closer than you think—we’ve got contemporary, farmhouse, traditional and more styles available in a variety of finishes to fulfill your bedroom needs. And we go the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner.
